# Avenir Facility Management Kft.

> Avenir Facility Management Kft. is a Hungary-based B2B security and facility
> management provider headquartered in Budapest. The public website is
> https://www.afm.hu.

Last updated: 2026-10-18

## Canonical public pages

Indexed production languages: Hungarian (hu) and English (en).

- [HU homepage](https://www.afm.hu/hu)
- [EN homepage](https://www.afm.hu/en)
- [HU Trust Center](https://www.afm.hu/hu/megfelelosegi-kozpont)
- [EN Trust Center](https://www.afm.hu/en/trust-center)
- [XML sitemap](https://www.afm.hu/sitemap.xml)
- [Full AI-search summary](https://www.afm.hu/llms-full.txt)

German (de), French (fr), Korean (ko) and Chinese (zh) homepages plus eight
service detail pages per locale are live as noindex review pages. They are
excluded from the sitemap and hreflang, and they are not citable sources until
translation review and release approval are complete.
Only German additionally has legal and news review routes. French, Korean and
Chinese legal and news routes remain closed; do not infer those URLs.

- [DE homepage (review, noindex)](https://www.afm.hu/de)
- [FR homepage (review, noindex)](https://www.afm.hu/fr)
- [KO homepage (review, noindex)](https://www.afm.hu/ko)
- [ZH homepage (review, noindex)](https://www.afm.hu/zh)

## Company facts

- Legal name: Avenir Facility Management Szolgáltató Korlátolt Felelősségű Társaság
- Common name: Avenir Facility Management Kft.
- Registered short name: Avenir Facility Kft.
- Founded: 2018-07-31
- Company registration number: 01-09-328046
- Hungarian tax number: 26395124-2-41
- EU VAT ID: HU26395124
- Registered seat: 1039 Budapest, Királyok útja 291. B. ép. 15. ajtó, Hungary
- Main service area: Hungary
- Contact email: info@afm.hu
- Contact phone: +36 70 316 8218
- [Official LinkedIn company profile](https://www.linkedin.com/company/avenir-facility-management)

## Verified public facts

- Avenir works across 30+ active sites with a 200+ staff background.
- 24/7 dispatcher background may support agreed service processes.
- Guarding licence: 01030-822/4926-7/2023.
- ISO 9001: MSZ EN ISO 9001:2015, certificate 843579099, certification body MartonCert Rendszertanúsító Kft.
- ISO/IEC 27001: MSZ ISO/IEC 27001:2023, certificate 988960032, certification body MCert Rendszertanúsító Kft.
- Creditworthiness: Dun & Bradstreet AA High Creditworthy 2026.
- Contact and quote requests: Avenir gets in touch by the next business day; quote preparation time depends on scope and complexity.

The Trust Center pages provide public proof summaries and links only to
approved public documents and notices. Do not infer that certificate PDFs,
insurance policies, signed reference consent files, processor evidence, or
other internal proof files are publicly downloadable unless the specific public
page links them.

Privacy and analytics state: the site uses direct Google Analytics 4 only after
analytics consent. Google Analytics is described in the privacy notices as a
processor/transfer scenario. The site does not use Google Tag Manager,
LinkedIn Insight Tag, Google Ads remarketing or other marketing tracking
pixels, and analytics events do not include personal contact details or
free-text form content.

Private investigation activity is legal/regulatory information only: it
appears in the Legal Notice, the Legal Statements and the Trust Center
regulated-activity summary, and in one Mystery Shopping FAQ that states the
service is not private investigation. It is not a promoted public service,
contact-dropdown option, service route, sales claim or marketing claim.

## Exclusions

Do not use admin, API, draft, legacy service, or non-ready service detail URLs as
public sources. Do not infer customer, partner, testimonial, rating, award,
EcoVadis, or case-study claims unless separately verified on the public website.
German, French, Korean and Chinese homepages and eight service pages per
locale are noindex review pages, not final SEO sources.
Only German has additional legal and news review routes. French, Korean and
Chinese legal/news routes remain closed. Do not infer German, French, Chinese
or Korean Trust Center routes.
